t: How the Knowledge Organization Auditor works (Signature)
title: How the Knowledge Organization Auditor works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Knowledge Organization Auditor does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach runs a frozen rulebook — schema rules, orphan rules, coherence rules, contradiction rules — deterministically over the full archive, so two audits of the same data produce the identical finding list. Each finding carries the record ID, the rule ID, and the evidence, forming an audit ledger. Re-audits diff against the previous ledger, showing exactly which problems were fixed and which are new. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
